en: A black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing a grand spa or resort complex nestled in a forested landscape. The large multi‑wing hotel and pavilion-style buildings feature mansard roofs, ornate facades, and long verandas overlooking formal gardens and walking paths crowded with elegantly dressed people in early 20th‑century fashion. In the foreground runs a tree‑lined road with a horse‑drawn carriage and an early automobile. The whole scene suggests a fashionable health resort or casino in a wooded, hilly area. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front of the card.
